tier.description: direct with ready-for-dispatch; lite or full with ready-to-plan; null otherwise

comment.description: Reporter-facing markdown: decision, evidence, next step, under about 200 words (sdlc-triage step 8). Posted for CD: plain language per ops/sdlc/process/writing-for-cd.md.

questions.description: 1-3 for needs-input, each answerable in a sentence, none the thread already answers. Posted for CD: plain language per ops/sdlc/process/writing-for-cd.md.

advisor.description: fable only with ready-to-plan, for judgment-heavy planning (sdlc-triage step 7); none otherwise

advisor_reason.description: One sentence: why the plan does or does not need an advisor; empty unless ready-to-plan. Posted for CD: plain language per ops/sdlc/process/writing-for-cd.md.
